notes: [[title:What's new]] [[new]] In-app updater. Segue now updates itself right inside the app, no manual downloads. [[improved]] Overlay font. The overlay now always shows Segue's proper font, even if it isn't installed on your system. Some setups were falling back to a plain system one. [[fixed]] Xbox menu pause. Menus no longer pause your music by mistake. The in-menu lock now blocks pause too, not just track skipping. More on the way. 🫶
headline: Overlay font + Xbox menu fixes
